editorial: Imagine the glitz of old Hollywood melting into a visceral, skin-crawling nightmare. You will find yourself trapped in a claustrophobic descent where the boundary between cosmetic perfection and biological horror completely dissolves. James Watkins delivers a masterclass in practical effects, turning the lead's physical degradation into a haunting metaphor for lost identity. If you crave a psychological thriller that prioritizes dread over jump-scares, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological tragedies and high-concept body horror.
